views.name: stone
views.title: The stone
views.caption: where it starts: a travertine slab, on a table in the sun

views.name: story-1
views.title: 1 · First touch
views.caption: tap the stone, tap its top, tap a side: a small raised platform

views.name: story-2
views.title: 2 · A traced wall
views.caption: trace across the stone from it: a wall grows along the stroke

views.name: story-3
views.title: 3 · An elevated connection
views.caption: a terrace tapped up higher; a trace from the platform's top along the wall's and up to it: landings on the wall, a step up at the end, piers where there's nothing under it

views.name: story-4
views.title: 4 · A resolved labyrinth
views.caption: a passage carved under the walkway (an arch carries it); the court walled in (paved, water, a cypress); a tower, and a trace from its top to the terrace: a bridge on one great arch (the rules' choice); every bit of dressing the rules' own

views.name: story-4-turned
views.title: From the other side
views.caption: the bridge's great arch, the passage under the walkway, the court

views.name: palette
views.title: With the palette
views.caption: the same, and pieces put by hand: a tall arch, a long bridge from its top, a pool, cypresses on the terraces

views.name: motifs
views.title: Motifs and dressing
views.caption: an arcade from the terrace to a marble tower (its bays alike, a parapet along it of its own accord); a flight run up to the terrace; the passage read as a lintel; brick, moss, ivy, lanterns and pots

views.name: motifs-turned
views.title: From the other side
views.caption: the flight up to the ivied terrace, and the arcade beyond it

views.name: dressing-close
views.title: Dressing, close
views.caption: brick and moss, the lantern on the marble tower

views.name: story-8
views.title: 8 · A labyrinth
views.caption: a cloister with a gallery of arches on its walls; a gate framing the stair beyond; the stair climbing behind a wall, its head showing over it; a bridge from its landing over the passage below to the cloister; a tall narrow slot bridged high up

views.name: houses
views.title: Houses, close
views.caption: roofs where they belong: hipped, a lean-to falling away from it, gabled, a marble tower's lead dome; doors and windows the rules' own

views.name: doors
views.title: Doors where ways meet walls
views.caption: the cloister's corner towers: doors where the gallery arrives, a door at the foot, a stair inside; slit windows

views.name: story-8-turned
views.title: From the other side
views.caption: the slot between the towers, the gallery, and the court inside

views.name: story-9
views.title: 9 · Features, placements and rhythms
views.caption: a colonnade along the plaza (massive columns, wide and even, an entablature, a balustrade on top); a terrace and its flight balustraded (the quick rhythm of balusters); a court screened by a jali; a house with mashrabiya at its upper windows, colonnettes at its doors and windows, a pergola over the yard before it

views.name: colonnade
views.title: The colonnade, close
views.caption: columns with a swell to their shafts, a moulded base and a cushioned capital; the entablature run on over them; a balustrade along the top, a jali round the tower

views.name: house-features
views.title: Mashrabiya, colonnettes, a pergola
views.caption: lattice boxes on corbels at the upper windows, the light through them in points; slim shafts framing the arches; posts, beams, close-set rafters and a vine over the yard

views.name: jali
views.title: A jali and balustrades
views.caption: the court's west side a screen of pierced stone; the terrace and its flight railed with turned balusters

views.name: story-10
views.title: 10 · Flow
views.caption: a wall traced on the diagonal, drawn as one straight diagonal wall; a court whose corners sweep round; a terrace out from a tower on piers that meet it in coves, arches between them; a wall traced across a stair's foot, leaving its way open

views.name: flow-close
views.title: Curves and diagonals, close
views.caption: the court's swept corners, and the diagonal wall running on into them

views.name: diagonal-close
views.title: A wall on the diagonal
views.caption: traced across the grid, laid as a stair-step of cells, drawn as one straight wall

views.name: piers-close
views.title: Piers that carry
views.caption: stone pushed out from a tower over nothing, on piers that meet it in coves (a round arch between them, not a box on stilts); the terrace's piers beyond

views.name: story-11
views.title: 11 · Gestures read
views.caption: a stroke drawn round back to its start: a court walled in, a gate where it began; a wall traced with two pauses: a gate at each; a climb too steep for its stroke: a stair tower, a door at its foot and a stair inside; a bridge traced through a taller tower: round it; a climb with a block in the way: round it to a straight flight

views.name: gestures-close
views.title: A stair tower, and ways round
views.caption: the stair tower beside the terrace; the bridge going round the tower in its way

views.name: land
views.title: The land
views.caption: a piece of land to build on: shelves rising to the back, a ravine with a stream down it, a rocky outcrop, a shelf flat enough for a court; drawn barely

views.name: story-12
views.title: 12 · On the land
views.caption: four gestures make a place: a court walled round on the shelf (a stroke drawn round it); a way up to its gate from the low ground (flights where the land rises, through the gate); a house raised across the ravine; a way over the stream to it

views.name: land-close
views.title: On the land, close
views.caption: the way climbing to the court's gate; the stream under the way to the house

views.name: land-2
views.title: Another
views.caption: another seed: another piece of land

views.name: story-7
views.title: Auto alone, no cap
views.caption: a tower tapped up ten high (no cap on height), a walkway to it, a long wall traced round, a high walkway from halfway up the tower (its slim piers stand aside on the ways below): every motif and all the dressing the rules' own choice

views.name: story-4-plain
views.title: Without the rules' dressing
views.caption: storyboard 4 as the hand built it, with ?plain: the stone bare

views.name: sheet
views.title: The piece brush's sheet
views.caption: hold the piece brush (or touch it again): the pieces, and the dressing

views.name: select
views.title: Taken up whole
views.caption: select: a tap takes up an arch, a second its whole arcade; read it as lintels, or solid; dress it; take it away

views.name: close
views.title: The stone, close
views.caption: dressed travertine in courses, its joints staggered; pitted and banded; the light gathered under an arch

views.name: print
views.title: As a print
views.caption: print: the light hatched, closer and crossed as it darkens
